en.row.regionEmptyHint: Sign in to a WorkBuddy account for this region in the desktop app, then choose “Detect accounts again”. Domestic and international accounts can be signed in side by side.
en.row.regionEmptyTitle: No {region} account is signed in yet.
en.row.regionHowTo1: Download and install the {region} client: the international build is named WorkBuddy AI while the domestic one is WorkBuddy, and they are different apps. The web version at https://www.workbuddy.ai/ also works.
en.row.regionHowTo2: Pick a sign-in method: email sign-up / sign-in (most common), OAuth with Google, GitHub or X, or WeChat QR scan on some builds.
en.row.regionHowTo3: Make sure this machine can reach overseas sites when signing in: the international version targets users outside mainland China and may fail to load behind a restricted network.
en.row.regionHowTo4: Back here, press the re-detect button. Every sign-in the client has left on this machine is absorbed into its own region - the two sides stay separate and can run at the same time.
en.row.regionHowToNote: The two versions keep separate accounts, credits and data: a domestic account cannot sign in to the international one, and vice versa, so each needs its own registration. This plugin only reads the sign-ins the client has already performed.
